parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target chembl_id 'CHEMBL1744525', standard_type 'IC50', standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
